purpose: Five stationary-arm native cycles; not moving-arm, S2, contact grasp or D3 admission
live_reader_policy: start at new records before preflight/each detached cycle; full raw files independently retained and gated
reference_reader_policy: require latest source fresh, filter reference eligibility by trigger epoch, require first eligible candidate fresh
audit_lifetime_policy: complete raw-prefix audit scoped and released before next live cycle; all raw retained
failure_receipt_policy: original exception, monotonic failure clock, stack and read-only reader snapshot
historical_stale_pause_cause: UNKNOWN; no retroactive reclassification or replacement
audit_boundary_policy: per-cycle raw read bounded by the cycle last declared frame and by the file size seen at open; later rows stay unread for the next cycle; whole-file verify_run and all raw bytes unchanged
worker_deadline_policy: declared floor max_cycles*(1.05 s+hold+settle)/min_preflight_rtf plus 5*25 s audit allowance and 30 s client allowance; a receipt below the floor is rejected
